meta.title: Codex body effects (optional)
meta.description: Replace the bottom Deep diving indicator with a top Worked elapsed-time header and divider. Add a gray moving highlight to active operations, disclosure motion, and Codex-like pencil and terminal icons. Reveal streaming body text smoothly in paragraph order instead of dumping whole blocks, draining at a fixed rate when the stream ends; blockquotes, complex lists and paragraphs that gain inline markup fade in as a whole. Hide live reasoning content while retaining DSH's completed reasoning disclosure and icon. Keep real messages, tool details, approvals, and file actions. On by default; requires the Codex UI component. Switching off restores DSH's original body presentation.
